dataset_title: Hypothetical roadside-grass collection-point tonnage case, East Flanders (2010 values reported in 2023 article)
source_dataset_file: Collection and Processing of Roadside Grass Clippings: A Supply Chain Optimization Case Study for East Flanders
source_table: Table 2; Scenario 1 narrative in Section 3.1 and Table 9
derivation: Transcribed the 41 Table 2 location values as printed, without conversion. Preserved the separately reported Table 2 total (9,931 t wet matter) and Scenario 1 narrative input (9,841 t wet matter) as separate records because they disagree.
units: t wet matter per collection/storage point per mowing, as described by source; aggregate records are source-reported t wet matter
applicability: Phase 1 supply-chain planning analogue for point-level spatial heterogeneity and collection/logistics scenario structure. Not a GreenHub supply estimate or runtime input.
uncertainty: No statistical uncertainty is reported for the location values. The source describes the allocation as hypothetical and the article has an internal 90 t discrepancy between the Table 2 total and Scenario 1 total.
limitations: The authors state that Table 2 represents a hypothetical case built from earlier Grenzeloze Logistiek estimates, not measured weighbridge observations.
Reported quantities combine roadside clippings from regional and municipal roads and may include material not collected at the named point or transported directly to a digester or composter.
The 41 location IDs are not geographic coordinates in the extracted table; the extract cannot support geospatial distance calculations.
The source table total is 9,931 t while its Scenario 1 narrative reports 9,841 t; both values are preserved without choosing one.
The values have no reported dry-matter basis, composition, seasonal split, accessibility, delivery contract, or harvest loss.
This dataset is reference-only and must not override user inputs, project measurements, feedstock defaults, or scenario configuration.
